{"diagnosis":"Batch 14 contains 333 re-delivered rows (ingested 05:00) whose txn_ts is epoch milliseconds instead of a timestamp string, which breaks the CAST. 1768716039000 ms is 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC, exactly the txn_ts of the original copy, and the other columns are identical. Fix: parse both timestamp formats and keep one row per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, ingest_ts,
         CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts
  FROM raw_transactions
), dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM parsed
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, ts) = 1
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM dedup
WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
